decision.summary: One candidate temporary offset in N/U (495–507) with abrupt onset, sustained interior, and incomplete recovery—no full return observed before end of allowed context. E shows compensating rise but no clear offset signature. No other intervals within [455,545] meet criteria for confirmed or uncertain temporary offset.

intervals.observation: N and U show correlated multi-sample drop starting ~495 (N: ~-2 to -4 MAD, U: ~-2 to -3 MAD), abrupt over 2–3 samples; E rises slightly. Interior (496–505) sustains offset. Return begins ~506 but remains incomplete by 507 (N still ~-1.5 MAD, U ~-1.8 MAD vs pre-event baseline); no opposing return observed within allowed context [455,545].
